fragments.title: Savings account opening
fragments.text: Identify customer, collect documents, run KYC, create account, ask for initial deposit when applicable, confirm account status.

fragments.title: International transfer review
fragments.text: Capture details, validate source account, screen beneficiary, request purpose document if needed, route to manager review, release or reject.

fragments.title: Loan refinance handling
fragments.text: Identify customer, read loan status, calculate conditions, compare options, prepare request, obtain approval.

fragments.title: Complaint intake
fragments.text: Create claim, collect evidence, classify claim type, assign owner, notify customer.
